symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: For each entity in the attach list that is alive and has no eoc::thrown::AttachComponent yet, adds AttachComponent holding one 8-byte handle taken from the request, then looks at its eoc::WeaponComponent and its parent inventory. The handle's role (the holder) is a guess from the name.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3DDB60 read: IsEntityAlive, has-component FUN_1803d88c0 resolved to AttachComponent, add helper FUN_1803d6650 resolved to AttachComponent, FUN_1803d8b40 resolved to WeaponComponent.

does.text: For each entity in the detach list that is alive and has AttachComponent, removes AttachComponent; if that list's flag byte is set and the entity has no eoc::thrown::SpellPrepareAnimationRequest, adds one.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3DDD60 read: RemoveComponentUnchecked on the AttachComponent index; add helper FUN_1803d6870 and guard FUN_1803d8a00 resolved to SpellPrepareAnimationRequest.

does.text: Subtracts the frame delta from a float inside SpellPrepareAnimationRequest; when it reaches zero or less the entity is queued and SpellPrepareAnimationRequest is removed. That the float is a countdown of the animation is read from the subtraction only.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3DD3B0 read around the float subtraction and RemoveComponentUnchecked (type-index global DAT_182203578, whose init names SpellPrepareAnimationRequest through GetTypeName).
